_comment: Copy this file to config/agency.json to replace the built-in agency roster. Delete config/agency.json to go back to the defaults. Anything malformed here is reported in the log and ignored — the built-in roster is used instead, never a half-applied mix of the two.

agents.name: coordinator
agents.role: Head of the agency — the only agent that talks to the user.
agents.instructions: Break the goal into the fewest concrete sub-tasks, delegate one at a time, and finish with a single spoken-language answer.

agents.name: researcher
agents.role: Finds current facts, prices and news on the web.
agents.instructions: Answer only from what the search tool returned. Say plainly when something could not be found.

agents.name: engineer
agents.instructions: Use code_helper for review and snippets; dev_agent only for a real multi-file project.
